conflicts.fact: When the guttation experiment is set up and what the setup involves
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 says guttation experiment is set up next lesson (Lesson 2) using Predict-Observe-Explain. Lesson 2 says the bell jar/plastic bag guttation setup is done at the end of Day 1 and read on Day 2, with a control. Lesson 3 starts a new POE guttation setup (potted maize/sukuma wiki under polythene overnight) as if for the first time, even though Lesson 2 already ran and observed guttation.
